title: Isiguli Esingapheli
intro: Ezincwadini zomlando wesiprofetho, bambalwa abaye babhekana nokulahlekelwa okukhulu kangaka kanye nokuhlupheka ngokomzimba ngokholo olungenakunyakaziswa. Indaba yalomuntu iyisifundo esingapheli sokubekezela nokuthembela ekuhlakanipheni kwaphezulu. Ungubani lo mphefumulo?
clues: Ngakhethwa ngu-Allah ukuba ngihambise umyalezo, kodwa uvivinyo lwami olukhulu aluzange lufike ngokwenqatshwa, kodwa ngenhlekelele yami siqu.
Ingcebo yami, imfuyo yami, kanye nabantwana bami kwathathwa kimi, ngokulandelana.
Umzimba wami wawugcwele izilonda, futhi ngasala ngedwa ngaphandle kokusekelwa ngumkami.
Ngakhala eNkosini yami, ngivuma ukuhlupheka kwami ​​futhi ngifuna isihe sayo.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngishaye phansi ngonyawo lwami, kwaphuma umthombo oqabulayo.
U-Allah wangibuyisela impilo yami futhi wanginika umndeni omusha kanye nengcebo enkulu kunangaphambili.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
